items.summary: The US professional basketball league is expanding into prediction markets with official data agreements and safeguards against insider trading.

items.summary: The Seoul government is reportedly weighing another delay for a 2020 income tax policy on digital assets, citing concerns with receiving data from US officials.

items.summary: The agreement adds S&P Dow Jones gauges to a growing list of Wall Street firms expanding their involvement in prediction markets.

items.title: PHP flaw shows AI ‘vulnerability apocalypse’ is on schedule: Immunefi CEO
items.summary: Mitchell Amador warned internet users that websites could remain compromised for weeks, particularly smaller websites slower to adopt the emergency upgrades.

items.title: Strategy skips Bitcoin purchases, spends $205M on STRC buybacks
items.summary: Strategy made no Bitcoin purchases or sales last week, as its STRC preferred stock buybacks reduced its USD Cash balance by 46% to $242.4 million.

items.title: Why Prediction Markets Got the Brazilian Election So Wrong
items.summary: Experts say Brazil's prediction market ban left the odds in the hands of traders with little knowledge about the election.

items.title: SpaceX Locks Up $40 Billion for AI Chips as Musk Warns Most Neoclouds Will Die
items.summary: Elon Musk says SpaceX closed a $40 billion chip deal with Apollo while lenders shut the door on smaller AI cloud firms, a split that could decide who controls computing.

items.title: Bitcoin Wallet Fixes Critical Flaw That Redirected Funds to Attackers
items.summary: A confirmed exploit let rogue servers replace Electrum’s pending transactions, tricking users into redirecting Bitcoin to attacker addresses.

items.title: India’s CoinDCX Confirms $16 Million Loss Days After CEO Called It a ‘False Alarm’
items.summary: The Mumbai-based exchange says 15.99 million USDT was drained from wallets it retired after last year’s $44 million hack, bringing its combined losses to nearly $60 million—and it’s absorbing the hit.

items.title: Brazil’s Stock Market Crashes After Lula’s Upset Victory
items.summary: The iShares Brazil ETF fell as much as 26% after Lula da Silva beat Flávio Bolsonaro, who prediction markets had at 80%, while the dollar jumped as much as 12% against the real.

items.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine Keeps Buying Ethereum But Pivots to Record Share Buybacks
items.summary: The firm added 10,452 ETH to reach 4.95% of supply, but its bigger move was repurchasing 2.04 million of its own shares—part of what it calls the largest equity buyback any crypto treasury company has run.

items.title: Hyperliquid says Kraken parent Payward to be first CFTC-regulated HIP-3 deployer
items.summary: Hyperliquid plans to make Kraken parent Payward the first CFTC-regulated HIP-3 deployer, a step toward regulated U.S. perpetual futures.
